altitude.description: Surface altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (0 to 32800 ft). Default 0.

bottom_time_min.description: Planned minutes at the depth after the descent, 1 to 300. When given, the answer says whether it is within the no-stop time and by how much. Example: 25 for "is 25 min at 30 m ok?".

depth.description: Depth in m (metric) or ft (imperial), 1 to 200 m (3 to 650 ft). Required.

gradient_factors.description: Gradient factors. The no-stop time is computed at GF high.

high.description: GF high, percent, 10 to 100. Sets the no-stop limit. Default 80.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen percentage of the gas, 5 to 100. Default 21 (air). Example: 32 for EANx32.

previous_share_url.description: Repetitive dive: the share link of the previous dive's plan_dive or check_no_deco result. Send with surface_interval_min.

surface_interval_min.description: Repetitive dive: surface interval since the previous dive, 15 to 1440 minutes. Send with previous_share_url.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

name: check_no_deco

margin_min.description: With bottom_time_min: minutes to spare (within) or over (over). null: no limit within the model.

mod_1_4_bar.description: MOD of the gas at 1.4 bar.

no_stop_minutes.description: Minutes at the depth after the descent before a stop is required, at GF high. 0: a stop is already required on arrival. null: no limit within the model.

ppo2.description: PPO₂ of the gas at the depth, bar.

share_url.description: Dive Kit link to a 1-minute plan at this depth.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

verdict.description: With bottom_time_min: within or over the no-stop time.

warnings.description: Titles of the plan warnings at this depth (hyperoxia, hypoxia, density, END).

title: No-stop time at a depth
